created_by: the contract-judgment v3 case, 2026-11-10: v3 passed its factory win-gates (paired fresh confirm 0.9048 vs incumbent 0.7619, held-out 1.0) but scored 5/12 on the acceptance battery against v2's 11/12 — its confirm surfaces were its own generator's idioms. The manual serving override that followed is now this standing rule.
note: Measured battery slices per adopted artifact — the evidence the standing serving rule (factory/registry.py) promotes on. Every number here is a measurement from a named battery run, never a claim copied from a model record (the contract-judgment-model-v3 record's battery_reference_acc field says 0.9167, inherited at adoption; its MEASURED slice is 0.4167 and the measured value is what the rule uses). New adoptions enter as shadow until a battery run measures their slice and this file is updated.
rule: An adopted artifact becomes the serving artifact only when its measured battery slice is >= the serving incumbent's slice. Until then it is registered as shadow: on the books, audited, never served, never a fallback.
